name: Thread similarity graph with voronoi territories

mentions.name: Thread similarity graph with voronoi territories
mentions.description: A web visualization that clusters the comments of a long Hacker News thread by similarity and renders them as a navigable graph with voronoi territories, so readers can explore the discussion. Built quickly as a one-off and hosted temporarily.
mentions.problem: The Hacker News thread was very long, making it difficult to navigate.
mentions.source_excerpt: This thread was so long I vibecoded a clustering similarity graph of it to navigate with voronoi territories, should be available for the next little bit.
